data.name: Description
data.value: The microphone Jarvis listens to and the output it speaks through. Each choice applies at once. What the microphone hears stays in memory and is never written to disk.

data.name: MutedHint
data.value: The microphone is muted: it is closed, nothing is captured, and Jarvis no longer answers "Hey Jarvis".

data.name: MissingHint
data.value: No microphone can be opened. Jarvis listens again as soon as one is connected.

data.name: DefaultHint
data.value: If the chosen microphone is missing, Jarvis listens through the Windows default until it comes back.

data.name: OutputHint
data.value: Where Jarvis speaks. If the chosen output is missing, the Windows default is used.

data.name: NoOutput
data.value: No audio output can be opened.

data.name: SaveFailed
data.value: The choice could not be saved: the settings file cannot be written. The cause is in the log.
